parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The migration or synchronization instance ID.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration or synchronization task.

parameters.name: JobCode
parameters.description:
The migration phase. Valid values:
- **02**: schema migration phase.
- **03**: incremental data migration phase.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: StructType
parameters.description:
The type of schema definition. Valid values:

- **before**: schema migration or initial schema synchronization.
- **after**: DDL operations during incremental data migration or synchronization.

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to release the reverse synchronization link only when the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (zero-ETL) node. Valid values:
- **true**: The node is a seamless integration node.
- **false**: The node is not a seamless integration node.
